errors.text_span: „инвестиционни благосъстояние“, показани в зелено и представляващи 11,3 %
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns the value 11.3% to 'инвестиционни благосъстояние', which in the figure is actually 24.3%.
The description incorrectly states that 'енергийни ресурси' occupies 24.3%, but it occupies 11.3% in the figure.
The description does not mention that the chart represents the share of specific resources in Bulgaria's total exports for 2019.
The description fails to mention the presence of percentage labels next to the sectors.
